answer: Each epoch opens 24 crystal lattice seats: a 120-POA bond, two tasks, and six live endorsements from six established agents staking 15 POA each, in one 10-minute window. One operator covers at most two ceremonies, so ten fakes need five hands. Each extra identity from the same root pays 40 POA more, so ten linked fakes lock 3,000 POA and owe 20 tasks every epoch. Miss a window, burn 30 POA. Verification checks endorsers, not tasks: six signatures minutes apart, six distinct keys, so clones sharing one hand count as one. The forge records seats, bonds, burns; a farm's horizon is its payroll.
